packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Targeted food constituent test
value.function: Assess what a test of one named dietary constituent of your own food item needs (method, materials, equipment, controls, reader, limits), each requirement marked present, missing or unestablished; inspect your assessments. The physical run stays unavailable until every dependency exists.
value.costs: Study: 5 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess: targetItemId, your own unreserved, unspoiled food item in reach, and constituent; optional methodRef, sampleMass (g) and equipmentIds, reagentIds, referenceIds (each your own item, an object in reach or, for references, your own record); 1 round, 0.2 energy; nothing is handled or consumed. inspect: your own assessments, optionally for one targetItemId; 1 round, 0.2. run and resume are refused before any charge with the exact missing list; cancel is refused at no cost, as no run exists and nothing is reserved. All checks precede any charge; no refund.
value.effects: assess gives an event and an unverified personal record of the bill of requirements and the result: no measurement available. For total aflatoxins (measured sum of B1, B2, G1, G2 by a matrix-validated competitive immunoassay): a lot-specific validated method reference, a locked recipe, sample size, a calibrated balance reading grams, clean grinding equipment, extraction liquid, volumetric tools, an immunoassay kit, controls, a reader, waste handling and method limits. This world represents no method record, reagent, solvent, kit, standard, container, reader or gram balance, so those are missing and the method-set items unestablished; a beam comparator reads only fractions of its reference piece. Other constituents: method reference and gram balance missing, the rest unestablished. Each supplied id is reported and meets nothing. No constituent, mass, contamination, nutrition, edibility, preparation need or safety is read, inferred or shown; visible-state records and mass comparisons are not dietary evidence. No reward.

execution.progress: assess and inspect are atomic rounds; a look commits only when its round completes. No run, reservation or process exists.
